Flashfire Thurible is provided by Lamplighter Kaerter to reveal Nightshade Abductors in Rambleshire for Holy Fire in Rambleshire.

Flat Earthen is an exploration achievement earned by getting crushed by a piece of machinery inside the central Forgegrounds building in Dornogal. Getting crushed can also earn an exasperated response from Darean, the blacksmithing trainer standing nearby. The nearby Incident Report will also be updated in accordance with accidents as they occur.
